response.sql:
WITH grouped_income AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_member,
    SUM(amount) as group_sum
  FROM income
  WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
total_income AS (
  SELECT SUM(group_sum) as total_sum
  FROM grouped_income
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gi.group_sum,
    CAST(gi.group_sum AS REAL) / CAST(ti.total_sum AS REAL) AS share
  FROM grouped_income gi, total_income ti
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_all_shares
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.group_sum) as total_amount,
  AVG(s.share) as average_share,
  AVG(s.share - a.avg_all_shares) as avg_diff_from_avg
FROM shares s, avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_all_shares;

assumptions.assumption: The average_share for filtering is computed across all groups (before filtering), not just the groups retained. The request says to 'take the plain average of the shares across groups' then 'Keep only groups whose share is strictly greater than that average'—the average is established before filtering.
